description: Local lead discovery as CSV: finds businesses for a category and area from Google Maps data, checks each profile, and returns up to 10 with at least one red flag (unclaimed, missing photos, hours or website, low rating, few reviews). No starting list required. Costs $0.75 per call via x402.

area.description: Area to search in: a city, region and country such as 'Austin, TX', 'Austin, Texas, United States' or 'Taichung, Taiwan'.

category.description: Business category to search for, matching a normal Google Maps search term.

name: tariffmonkee-lead-discovery
